_comment: Justifications for ONE-SIDED twin re-pins (renquant-pipeline#232). An entry suppresses the CI finding for exactly one pair moving from one exact digest tuple to one exact digest tuple, and it REMAINS VALID for as long as the pins still sit at its new_* tuple -- it is an audit record of a movement that happened, not a token consumed by one diff. It is reported SUPERSEDED the moment either side moves again, because it then describes a state that no longer exists and would pre-authorise a movement nobody justified. It cannot be written in advance. `reason` must be non-empty: a justification with no justification is a rubber stamp. Required keys per entry: pair, old_public_sha256, old_kernel_sha256, new_public_sha256, new_kernel_sha256, reason.

exceptions.reason: pipeline#250 serving-feature-persistence rollout step 2: the kernel copy gains three stage_serving_features() calls at its serving-transform sites (post transform_feature_frame / at the exact scorer.score consumption points). Those sites exist ONLY in the kernel copy -- the public twin scores a caller-supplied dict matrix (ctx.panel_feature_matrix) and never runs the serving transform the #250 design names, so there is no as-served matrix object to record there. The recorder is additive and record-don't-raise; no admission behaviour changes on either side (pinned by tests/test_serving_feature_persistence.py decisions-unchanged test).
